PROJECT 01

E-Commerce Mobile Application

End-to-end shopping experience with live payments

A complete storefront in React Native: product discovery and search, favourites, cart, checkout with shipping addresses, order history and Stripe payment workflows — plus camera capture, Arabic/English localization and dark mode across every screen.

  • Stripe checkout & card scanning
  • Supabase auth + email verification
  • Cart, favourites & order history
  • Search, offers & new arrivals
  • i18next Arabic / English
  • System-aware dark mode

PROJECT 02

Advanced Weight Tracker

Sensor-driven health tracking with cloud sync

The largest of the three. Reads device pedometer and motion sensors to track steps, calories, distance and active time, layers food, water and weight logging on top, then rolls it all into weekly and monthly reports with achievements, challenges and PDF export.

  • Expo Sensors pedometer tracking
  • Background fetch & task manager
  • Weekly / monthly chart reports
  • Challenges, achievements & streaks
  • Push notifications & reminders
  • PDF export + premium tier

PROJECT 03

Calora — Nutrition & Activity Tracker

Guided onboarding to personalised daily targets

A nutrition companion that profiles the user through goal, activity level and basic info, then calculates and tracks daily calorie and macro targets. Food and workout logging, water and step tracking, body measurements, camera scanning and exportable progress reports.

  • Multi-step onboarding & goal engine
  • Food log with macro breakdown
  • Workout log & weight tracking
  • expo-camera scan workflow
  • Reminders, haptics & chart reports
  • CSV export & bilingual UI

Capabilities

What I actually own on a team.

Comfortable taking a feature from ticket to merged — and comfortable being the person who debugs it at 11pm.

◱

Responsive UI systems

Mobile-first layouts and reusable components that stay consistent across device sizes, orientations and themes.

⇄

API & data integration

REST services, Supabase, auth flows, token handling, optimistic updates and synchronised cloud state.

◷

Offline & persistence

AsyncStorage caching, background fetch and task manager so the app keeps working without a connection.

◔

Data visualisation

Interactive charts for weekly and monthly reporting using chart-kit and gifted-charts, tuned for mobile performance.

⌘

Native device features

Camera, pedometer and motion sensors, haptics, push notifications, image picking and share sheets.

ع/A

Localization & theming

Full Arabic/English i18n including RTL considerations, plus light and dark theme contexts wired app-wide.
